settings.refresh.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
settings.refresh.description: Query both subscriptions every 1–120 minutes. Manual refresh is always available.
settings.timeout.label: Query timeout (seconds)
settings.timeout.description: Allow 5–55 seconds per CLI query. Changes apply to the next query.
settings.countdown.label: Show reset countdown
settings.countdown.description: Show time until reset beside each quota. Local reset times remain in the popup.
settings.width.label: Progress bar width
settings.width.description: Width of each quota progress bar, from 24 to 100 logical pixels.
